title: Live Qwen generation measurements
items: Qwen now reports real generated-token counts and generation speed during every Deep stage, including the hidden draft and review.
Input tokens are clearly labeled as request size, separate from the context capacity and live output measurements.
Last model output and last runtime contact are shown separately. A quiet-output warning does not treat heartbeats as generation or claim the model has frozen.
Older runs show when live measurements are unavailable. Update FUPCJ with Update-Venture.ps1 and start a new request to use the new measurements.
Deep's three stages, thinking budgets, selected model and context remain unchanged. Stop remains available, and only the final answer is saved to the conversation.
